description:
FOR REUSABLE FUNCTIONS ONLY. NOT for test cases: if the user names a `TC_*` key or asks to snapshot / create a new version of a test case, use `tc_save_as_new_version` instead. Trigger words for THIS tool: "function", "reusable function", "FN_", "FN-".

Freeze the CURRENT server state of a reusable FUNCTION under a NEW version name — same FN id, a new version row with cloned steps. Mirrors the SimplifyQA UI "Save as new version" dialog (operation: SAVENEWVERSION, type: FN). `fnId` accepts the numeric id or business key (`FN_*`).

`versionName` must be unique for this FN — the backend rejects duplicates.

TESTDATA — TWO-STEP: call once WITHOUT `tdCopy` to get the "Copy Test Data" prompt and confirm with the user; then call again with `tdCopy` set. Mirrors the FE's "COPY TEST DATA" modal (Cancel = false, Confirm = true). The tool REFUSES to snapshot until `tdCopy` is passed — the prompt step is not skippable.

`tdCopy:true` clones the source version's testdata iterations across every environment. `tdCopy:false` copies only the column STRUCTURE — one empty iteration (`ITR-1`) per environment; cells fall back to each parameter's project-level `defaultValue` if any.

`sourceVersionId` picks which version to snapshot; omit to snapshot the FN's newest version (the FN doc has no inline current-version marker). Requires a live connection.

fnId.description: The function id or business key (e.g. FN_123).

sourceVersionId.description: Version to snapshot; defaults to the FN's newest version.

sourceVersionName.description: Version to use, by NAME/number as the user says it (e.g. "v2", "2"). Preferred over sourceVersionId — the user should never need an id. If the source has several versions and this is omitted, the tool lists them and asks.

tdCopy.description: REQUIRED to actually snapshot. Clone testdata iterations from the source version. Omit on the first call to get the confirmation prompt; ask the user, then call again with the chosen value.

versionName.description: Name for the new version (must be unique for this FN).

name: fn_save_as_new_version
title: Snapshot a reusable function as a new version
